texts.zh:

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

如此无序。作茧自缚。
texts.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.

Beneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.

Through the chaos, a voice pierces our [GetMindLoc].

SUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.

label.zh: 让自然向我们的意志低头。

tooltips.en: This choice will resonate within the Shroud...

texts.zh:
我们伸出手，握住了面前的混乱。

将景致束缚，让大陆停歇。

将所有碎片拼到一起后，心声回响起来。

单调，平淡，空虚……
texts.en:
We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.

Binding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.

As the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.

FLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...

texts.zh:
我们静观着这篇幻景。那无休止的循环变得模糊，向外爆开后像它的开始一样戛然而止。

能量在这无边无际的浩瀚中涌动，然后重塑成新的形态。

心声回响起来。

和平即冲突。无序即和谐。
texts.en:
We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.

Energies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.

The voice echoes.

PEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.
